scripts.dev: npm run buildings:compile && concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @msimcity/server" "npm run dev -w @msimcity/client"
scripts.build: npm run buildings:compile && npm run build -w @msimcity/client
scripts.build:local: npm run buildings:compile && npm run build:local -w @msimcity/client
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/shared/scripts && tsc -p packages/server && tsc -p packages/client && npm run -s local:check
